basis: Complete selected Model/Entity/Renderer Java source read; fixed remote sources fetched and compared to available cache. Exact Citadel 5633260 animation interpolation/end semantics not read here. No runtime proof.
held_object_socket: None declared by these body/model/render classes; horn hierarchy is anatomy, not handheld item mount.
death_contact: No own dedicated death/hurt model clip or terrain/contact solver in selected files. Inherited MobRenderer/LivingEntity death handling not closed. Does not qualify for quadruped death-contact register.
structure: 11 nodes/10 edges/12 box calls; root→body→chest→head→horns+ears. Rear supports belong to body; fore supports to chest.
22×23×20 chest overlaps 18×20×21 rear body; 12×14×9 head plus 8×8×10 muzzle forms low forward mass, not a humanoid torso with horns.
4 unsegmented legs, no knees, jaw or terrain-aware feet. Default head pitch22.5deg. No requirement to copy its missing joints into Dynasty.
layers: animate resets default and updates animator first; four keyframe branches. setupAnim adds diagonal gait/bobs, idle and then headYaw×.8/headPitch×1 after clips, without per-clip look gate.
Flick ears: 6×2+reset7=19 literal model ticks vs20 entity ticks; exact helper interpretation unclosed. Eat6×5+reset5=35 matches35.
Fling5 windup +3 throw +hold2+reset5=15; body/head/fore-support preparation precedes head -60deg target. Slash4×5+hold5+reset5=30, bilateral head sweeps with body translation.
entry_effect_end: Server idle entry requires NO_ANIMATION and absent/dead target; eat additionally velocity²<.03,random1/500,grass; ears random1/200. Eat at tick30 consumes grass/heals10 before reset completion.

Attack entry only NO_ANIMATION; live target dist<width+3 chooses slash/fling. Effects additionally dist<width+1.5 and LOS. Fling inclusive5..8; slash9..11 and19..21. These are attempted effect windows, not guaranteed multiple successful damage events.

AnimationHandler is called before the entity server branch; setAnimation only assigns. Loss of target prevents effects but no explicit clip cancel/reset here; target acquisition during eat does not visibly interrupt it. Global helper behavior remains unknown.

ANGRY reflects targetdistance<20 and switches PNG independently of clip. Potion overlay re-renders animated parent model with potion RGB at normal packed light, not a newly emitted mesh or proven emissive effect.
render: Renderer scale1.1; normal/angry PNG plus potion cutout overlay. Shadow .9.

Young body.5 with head1.35/childscale true, legs Y1.3, horns hidden. Restores head/leg scales and horns true after normal render; childscale flag not reset here, exception paths not guarded by finally. Exact helper behavior not proved.
application: For a heavy quadruped use a dominant foremass with supports parented to that mass, not an equal grid of cubes.
Align head/horn preparation with existing server contacts; never copy windows, damage or AI to Dynasty.
Before importing a rest/death solution require an actual same-scope example; this living combat source does not close the death-contact gap.
